description: This file defines internal static metrics instruments for application requests, including counters and histograms for request timeouts, cancellations, and latency histograms. It provides methods to record request completion times, timeouts, and cancellations as part of the application's diagnostics and monitoring system.

classes.name: ApplicationRequestInstruments
classes.description: A static class encapsulating metrics instruments for application request monitoring.

methods.name: OnAppRequestsEnd
methods.description: Records the end of an application request, updating the latency histogram aggregator if enabled.

methods.name: OnAppRequestsTimedOut
methods.description: Increments the counter tracking timed-out requests.

methods.name: OnAppRequestsCanceled
methods.description: Increments the counter for canceled requests.
